source: Derived from Idea/Bimba/Seeds/M/plans/2026-07-03-cycle-3-recapture-register.md §2 (LAW/SEAMS/CARRIER per track). Enforced by .codex/scripts/m-dev-plan-assess.mjs classViolations() at --mark done time.
carrierUfRule: A track whose CARRIER is a pratibimba-app surface (engine/panes) is UF, not K: closing a carrier tranche must cite real app-flow proof (playwright/test:e2e/app-smoke), because a jsdom mount or substrate-only proof never opens the app. Demonstrated 2026-07-09: track 02 T2.5 closed K on a jsdom mock that hand-crafted the profile shape and HID a real read-path bug (inversionOperator read at profile.inversionOperator instead of profile.harmonicProfile.inversionOperator); the visual-panes e2e caught it on the first real-app run. The tranche's own Verify line still carries its substrate command, so UF adds the app gate without dropping substrate proof. SIBLING HOLE (flagged, not yet flipped): tracks 01/03/04/05 are the M0/M2/M3/M4 subsystem carriers, still K — same exposure.

classDefinitions.K: Kernel/substrate — receipt.command must be a real test runner (cargo/make/node --test/pnpm test/pytest). C+Rust law, LUTs, contract crates.
classDefinitions.W: Wire/gateway — receipt must additionally reference live-wire, gateway, smoke, or wire-capture proof: a spawned gateway exercised over the real protocol. Manifest-string tests cannot close these.
classDefinitions.UF: UI flow — receipt must additionally reference playwright/test:e2e/smoke/ui-flow proof: the real surface driven in a real browser or the scripted boot gate. jsdom-only proof cannot close these.
classDefinitions.D: Document/spec deliverable — base receipt rules apply; the deliverable file is the work product and the SEED-HARMONISATION adversarial gate is the reviewer.
